rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for the main or primary person, thing, or role.

example.english: This is the principal goal of our plan.
example.traditional: 呢條係我哋計劃嘅主要目標。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 hai6 ngo5 dei6 gai3 waak6 ge3 zyu2 jiu3 muk6 biu1

rows.note: Use this when “principal” specifically stresses being the most important rather than simply the main one.

example.english: Ming plays the principal role on the team.
example.traditional: 阿明喺隊入面擔當最重要嘅角色。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 hai2 deoi6 jap6 min6 daam1 dong1 zeoi3 zung6 jiu3 ge3 gok3 sik1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for money originally invested or borrowed on which interest is calculated.

example.english: The more principal there is, the higher the interest.
example.jyutping: bun2 gam1 jyut6 do1 lei6 sik1 zau6 jyut6 gou1

rows.note: Use this for the chief administrator of a school, rather than for financial principal.

example.english: The principal announced the new school rules in the hall today.
example.traditional: 校長今日喺禮堂宣布新校規。
example.jyutping: haau6 zoeng2 gam1 jat6 hai2 lai5 tong4 syun1 bou3 san1 haau6 gwai1
